title: Holds
description: Capacity taken off public sale — who it is for, who put it there, and when it goes back.
searchPlaceholder: Who it is for, product or staff…
kindHelp_capacity: Takes a number of places off sale, leaving the rest sellable.
kindHelp_session: Stops all sales on that session. Nothing is left to sell.
kindHelp_resource: Blocks one field, lane or court for the time you choose.
kindHelp_seats: Takes named seats out of the seat picker.
empty_converted: No hold has become a booking yet
emptyMessage: Hold capacity when a group has asked for places but has not paid yet.
newHoldDescription: Held places stop being sellable straight away. The preview says exactly what you are taking off sale.
timeHelp: Leave empty to hold across the whole day.
quantityHelp: These come straight off what the counter can sell.
seatsHelp: Separate with commas, as they appear on the seat map.
heldForHelp: A school, a partner, an event. In six weeks this is the only thing that explains the block.
reasonHelp: Anything the next person needs to know.
expiryHelp: In days. Leave empty to hold it until someone releases it by hand.
preview_capacity: {what} places on {product}, {when}, come off sale and are held for {heldFor}.
preview_session: {product} on {when} stops selling entirely, held for {heldFor}.
preview_seats: {what} seats on {product}, {when}, come out of the seat picker for {heldFor}.
previewNoExpiry: It stays until someone releases it.
